assets.name: The Sandbox
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: environment concept for Rootward, a programmer-humour fantasy dungeon dive. Reference image 1 is the current title's art direction ONLY: warm worn stone, ornate aged brass, industrial roots/cables, lanterns, painterly stylized detailed fantasy. Create a new room, not a copy. Single full-bleed wide 16:9 environment painting, no collage, no border. A combat arena viewed horizontally from the side with mild depth perspective, camera steady at character eye height. A continuous broad level stone fighting floor extends left-to-right across the full width in the bottom 22% of image, clear unobstructed feet line at about 84% image height; all large scenic props behind that plane. Empty playable space at left and right for future fighters, quiet dark middle-value backdrop behind their silhouettes. Background reveals a deep vertical shaft and older structures continuing downward, never open sky. Rich brown charcoal stone, brass gold trim and amber light in every layer. Architectural shapes and localized lighting matter more than tiny decoration. No people, no creatures, no characters, no battle UI, no computer monitors, no flat neon cyberpunk, no modern server racks, no text other than the small physical plaques explicitly requested. Keep any plaque incidental and outside the fighter silhouette zones.
Scene: Ring 3, THE SANDBOX / USERSPACE, the first underground boundary beneath the title's lift station. A welcoming but abandoned arcaded sandstone chamber suspended above a huge shaft. Uneven repaired masonry and battered timber side workshops, reclaimed code-like etched stone fragments held in shallow brass-edged trays, rough sand piled behind an actual low sandbox retaining wall in the BACKGROUND. A brass cage lift at the far-left background and a warmly lit iron portcullis at the far right background lead deeper. Through broad arches in the central rear wall see tiny lower galleries and lanterns falling away into smoky darkness. Soft amber ochre light, dusty muted sage moss and little dried root tangles, brown stone dominant. Make this specifically a dungeon of discarded programs and bounded experiments, friendly surface-level disorder. A small brass plaque attached to the far-right gate reads exactly "chmod +x"; a smaller bench plaque says "Hello, World". Physical objects integrated naturally, restrained humour. Thin copper boundary inlaid across BACKGROUND gate threshold implies permission boundary. Keep foreground fighting floor clean, quiet and wide. Detailed painted fantasy game art matching reference richness.

Scene: Ring 2, THE HEAPWORKS / ALLOCATION CAVERNS. A much deeper subterranean archive-industrial cavern. This is a disorganized physical heap of allocated space, not a library. Large readable block silhouettes and taller heavier clutter on the BACKGROUND edges, wide flat uncluttered foreground combat floor. Painted ornate fantasy machine dungeon consistent with reference, visibly different from upper sandstone workshops.

Scene: Ring 1, THE INTERRUPT FOUNDRY / DRIVER WORKS. A deep immense black-brown basalt machinery hall whose back wall is crossed by thick copper signal buses, pressure pipes and brass insulator collars. Behind the broad flat foreground battle floor sits a rear railing above a deep shaft, with a colossal toothed timing flywheel, hefty shaft bearings and synchronized smaller gear pairs high in the rear wall. Lower rear platforms and bus bridges disappear down into smoky darkness beneath the machinery. The central BACKGROUND feature is a heavy square iron interrupt gate with three amber-red annunciator lamps and warm narrow furnace seams. Machines feel like ancient dungeon mechanisms, heavy and grounded. Palette is dark chocolate basalt, burnished brass, amber lamps, copper-red heat localized to BACKGROUND slits, never rivers of lava. Suggest devices requesting attention through bells and sequenced signal bulbs, no modern screens. Clean continuous quiet slate fighting floor, large side machinery stays behind stage, balanced dark space behind future fighters, painterly fantasy richness.

Scene: Ring 0, THE KERNEL / ROOT SANCTUM, the deepest and final chamber at the bottom of the entire Machine. The rough stone becomes enormous immaculately fitted charcoal basalt blocks and deliberate symmetrical brass traces. An ancient subterranean computational sanctum, intimate but monumental, not a sunlit church. In the rear middle beyond a low railing is a huge square aged brass processor socket standing upright like a sealed shrine: nested rectilinear plates, a small intensely luminous ivory-gold square core inside, four thick braided rootlike copper conduits flowing downward and converging into it, elegant dark arches and sealed blank stone behind. A circular permission seal carved into the rear dais surrounds the SQUARE kernel assembly. Roots become precisely routed gold-inlaid circuit paths, low pools of gold light, no clutter. Soft deep smoke at side vents, black-brown background, restrained antique gold and ivory illumination give authority and danger. A small physical brass plate below shrine reads "RING 0" and a small plaque on far-right sealed access gate reads "sudo". Much quieter, more ordered than upper rings, ominous impossible depth and strong final destination, no daylight, no lava, no sky. Painterly fantasy game scenery matching reference.

assets.name: Descent map
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Shardrun route-map environment concept for Rootward. Reference image 1 is current title's fantasy machine dungeon style only. Generate a new wide 16:9 painterly cutaway environment, no UI, no text, no icons, no route dots, no lettering. View an enormous UNDERGROUND dungeon shaft in cross-section with FOUR distinct horizontal architectural strata stacked top to bottom, all visible in ONE composition, like a richly illustrated dungeon section. The strata have roughly equal heights, each about one quarter of canvas height. Top quarter: RING 3 warm ochre sandstone sandbox workshops, ragged root cables, tiny brass cage lift entrance and small amber lanterns. Second quarter: RING 2 irregular cuboid brass memory-vault stacks, collection crane, oxidized teal coolant leaking into recesses. Third quarter: RING 1 enormous copper bus conduits, heavy brass timing gears and dark industrial basalt, localized red-amber signal lights. Bottom quarter: RING 0 perfectly ordered fitted black basalt, precise gold traces, nested square brass processor shrine with small bright ivory-gold SQUARE kernel core at the bottom centre. These are fantasy dungeon architecture strata, NOT a flat modern computer drawing. The central 55% contains open dark shaft air crossed by small offset terraces and bridges at different heights that can later host independent route markers. Keep this central shaft quieter, medium dark, with readable room-sized shelves but no predefined route diagram. Detailed architectural walls and machinery frame left and right sides. Stairs, conduits, roots and lift chains clearly DESCEND through the strata toward the root shrine. No upward-pointing arrows, no mountain summit, no open sky. Depth intensifies downward, haze behind planes, brown stone/brass/amber binds all layers while each stratum has a visibly different silhouette. Generous broad shapes readable as map background. Match the provided warm ornate painted title environment, not sketch, not pixel art, no characters, no modern server racks or neon cyberpunk. Full bleed one painting, no border or panels.
